sql: select e.key, e.state, g.gate_key, r.verdict, r.computed_by, d.deployment_key, d.ended_at is not null as deployment_ended from experiments e join experiment_versions v on v.experiment_id=e.id join experiment_gates g on g.version_id=v.id left join experiment_gate_results r on r.gate_id=g.id left join experiment_epochs ep on ep.version_id=v.id left join experiment_deployments d on d.epoch_id=ep.id where e.key like 'marktangle%' order by e.key, g.gate_key
purpose: final verification of both MARKTANGLE close-outs
